review_locator: PMID:11051204, Selectin glycoprotein ligands review; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
primary_title: Purification and quantification of L-selectin-reactive GlyCAM-1 from mouse serum
decision_basis: The reviews identify GlyCAM-1 as a selectin glycoprotein ligand and the cited primary purification study reports that purified mouse GlyCAM-1 is L-selectin-reactive and also interacts with E-selectin.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only edge from purified mouse GlyCAM1; preserve secreted ligand and selectin-interaction context, with no E-selectin rolling/function or GlyCAM1 intracellular relay inferred.

review_locator: PMID:11051204, Selectin glycoprotein ligands review; PMCID:PMC7355470, Selectins review
primary_title: Identification of human complement Factor H as a ligand for L-selectin
decision_basis: The reviews place glycoprotein counter-receptors among selectin ligands and the cited primary study identifies human complement Factor H by L-selectin affinity chromatography and demonstrates Ca2+- and sialylation-sensitive binding to L-selectin.
limitations_preserved: Binding-only candidate for a post-translationally modified human Factor H fraction; preserve plasma purification and sialylation dependence, and do not infer physiological rolling or a Factor H intracellular relay.

limitations_preserved: Preserve beta4 tail/FnIII-domain and epithelial hemidesmosome context; no generalized integrin signaling or SCI inference.

decision_basis: CIB1 binds the alphaIIb cytoplasmic tail through a mapped hydrophobic interface
limitations_preserved: Preserve platelet alphaIIb-beta3 and cation-dependent affinity context; binding alone does not establish integrin activation.

primary_title: The cytoplasmic tail of L-selectin interacts with members of the Ezrin-Radixin-Moesin (ERM) family of proteins: cell activation-dependent binding of Moesin but not Ezrin
decision_basis: The L-selectin cytoplasmic tail associates with moesin in an activation-dependent ERM interaction
limitations_preserved: Moesin binding is activation-dependent; retain bounded shedding/rolling and cortical-cytoskeleton context without a universal signaling relay.

primary_title: The cytoplasmic tail of L-selectin interacts with members of the Ezrin-Radixin-Moesin (ERM) family of proteins: cell activation-dependent binding of Moesin but not Ezrin
decision_basis: The L-selectin cytoplasmic tail associates with ezrin in an ERM interaction
limitations_preserved: Association is stronger than a unique ezrin-only functional branch; preserve microvillar/cortical context and no universal signaling claim.

primary_title: Calmodulin regulates L-selectin adhesion molecule expression and function through a protease-dependent mechanism
decision_basis: Calmodulin directly associates with the L-selectin cytoplasmic domain and limits proteolytic shedding
limitations_preserved: Preserve protease-dependent ectodomain shedding and do not infer intracellular kinase signaling.

primary_title: The cytoplasmic tail of L-selectin interacts with the adaptor-protein complex AP-1 subunit mu1A via a novel basic binding motif
decision_basis: The L-selectin tail binds AP-1 subunit mu1A through basic and acidic tail motifs and supports retrograde trafficking
limitations_preserved: Endocytic/retrograde trafficking association only; do not claim a complete AP-1 complex or productive signaling.

decision_basis: The nectin-1 C-terminal EAYV motif binds the afadin PDZ domain and supports epithelial junctional adhesion
limitations_preserved: Preserve the terminal EAYV motif and nectin/afadin junction context; no independent cadherin or SCI relay.

primary_title: Solution structure of NOD1 CARD and mutational analysis of its interaction with the CARD of downstream kinase RICK
decision_basis: NOD1 CARD interacts with the RIPK2/RICK CARD in a mutationally mapped receptor-proximal complex
limitations_preserved: Cytosolic PRR and overexpression/mutant context; recruitment alone is not sufficient for signaling and no SCI inference is made.

decision_basis: NOD2 CARD-dependent interaction with RIPK2/RICK supports a proximal adaptor relay in MDP-responsive systems
limitations_preserved: Direct interaction is strongest in recombinant/overexpression systems; preserve tandem-CARD dependence and MDP context.

primary_title: TICAM-1, an adaptor molecule that participates in Toll-like receptor 3-mediated interferon-beta induction
decision_basis: TLR3 recruits the TICAM1/TRIF adaptor through TIR-domain interaction to support poly(I:C)-induced signaling
limitations_preserved: Preserve TLR3 intracellular signaling context; no universal IFN or terminal-TF inference.

decision_basis: TLR4 recruits TICAM2/TRAM as a bridging adaptor for endosomal TICAM1/TRIF signaling
limitations_preserved: Requires TLR4/MD-2 and endosomal trafficking context; TRAM is an intermediary, not the terminal adaptor.

decision_basis: TRAM bridges TLR4 to TRIF in endosomal signaling systems, with physical adaptor interaction and downstream IFN-beta/IRF3 readouts
limitations_preserved: Preserve TRAM as intermediary; do not collapse this into direct TLR4-to-TRIF binding.

primary_title: MyD88 adapter-like (Mal)/TIRAP interaction with TRAF6 is critical for TLR2- and TLR4-mediated NF-kappaB proinflammatory responses
decision_basis: TIRAP/MAL directly interacts with TRAF6 and supports TLR2/TLR4 proximal NF-kB responses
limitations_preserved: TIRAP is a bridging adaptor, not a receptor; preserve the E190 TRAF6-binding motif and avoid new terminal-TF inference.
